claims.summary: Fallen Empires 1994-11-01, credited artist Melissa A. Benson.

The black Order gains first strike only after paying {B}, and each {B}{B} activation gives +1/+0. Its protection from white does not stop green or red creature damage, and its own black color cannot block creatures that have protection from black. A 2/1 Order of the Ebon Hand can block a Kird Ape that is 2/3 because of Taiga's Forest type. Paying {B} and then {B}{B} grants first strike and +1/+0, making the Order 3/1. It kills the Ape during first-strike damage; the Ape deals no normal combat damage.
